title: fix(mcp): keep text tool responses non-streaming
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Removes unreachable stream fields from the Pollinations MCP text tool
- Keeps the standard single terminal MCP tool result instead of misusing progress notifications for token output
- Adds HTTP transport coverage for the upstream chat-completion request

Tests:
- apps/mcp Worker suite: 6/6
- packages/mcp deterministic client suite: 6/6

gist.headline: One answer, properly delivered
gist.blurb: The MCP text tool has stopped trying to narrate every token on the way out. Polli now delivers one tidy final answer, as the protocol intended.
gist.summary: Fixed the Pollinations MCP text tool to return a single terminal tool result by removing unreachable streaming fields and avoiding progress notifications for chat-completion tokens.
gist.impact: MCP clients now receive complete text responses through the standard tool-result flow, with HTTP transport coverage keeping that behavior pinned down.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a careful postal worker at a cozy retro terminal, carrying one sealed text-response envelope to the eager monitor robot instead of scattering tiny token notes around the room. A small code-plant and flowers reinforce that the response path is now clean and orderly.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art MCP workshop where Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot wearing a tiny postal cap, hands one neat sealed envelope labeled "FINAL RESULT" to a happy CRT monitor robot beside a lime green (#ecf874) terminal; discarded tiny token slips sit neatly in a recycling basket, with code-plants and flowers nearby. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, chunky sprites, subtle CRT glow, emotionally warm.
